info.title: Holo Folder API
info.description: Premium/lifetime data API. MCP uses OAuth separately. Card image fields are R2-only.

post.description:
STAGED, not admitted: valid authorized requests return 503 native_operations_staged until #379.  Migration 093 adds committed terminal noncommit proofs: REST 409 storage_creation_rejected or storage_import_rejected, MCP isError with strict error.rejection (outcome, original operationId, known code, inventoryRevision). Exact accepted/rejected replay is permanent and precedes mutable reconstruction after current authority checks. Arbitrary conflicts, billing, cancellation, failed COMMIT and network errors remain unknown. Consumers must bind the trusted response to the original family, immutable intent and owner/session scope; proof alone never authorizes discard. Fresh complete current reads and explicit reconciliation are a separate consumer gate. MCP outputSchema describes accepted receipts only; holofolder.com/errorSchemas declares errors. Atomic JSON v2 arrangement into an empty or target-only native collection with an already identical copied manifest. Every copy needs an explicit add or versioned existing-copy move. Retain the immutable request after unknown outcome. Does not replace collections/configuration, import assets, restore changed same-owner snapshots or authorize backup IDs.

Required permissions: `collection:write`, `binders:write`. MCP tool: `import_storage_arrangement`.

post.description:
STAGED, not admitted: valid authorized requests return 503 native_operations_staged until #379. After future admission, a committed terminal ledger rejection returns REST 409 storage_command_rejected or MCP isError with the same error.rejection: outcome, original operationId, known code and inventoryRevision. Other conflicts/timeouts are not rejection proof. MCP outputSchema describes accepted receipts only; holofolder.com/errorSchemas metadata declares errors. Atomic stable-ID slot insert/update/clear/remove/reorder. Requires exact inventory, collection, layout, slot/item/placement revisions and retry-stable operationId. Clear/remove release copies to Unassigned; neither deletes ownership. Set privateFields=preserve for create/reorder/target-only updates without replacing hidden wants; omitted or replace retains legacy full-replacement semantics.

Required permissions: `collection:write`, `binders:write`. MCP tool: `execute_slot_commands`.

privateFields.description: preserve allows public patchGrading and exact selected-want expectedPublic; rejects full grading/wants replacement and slot/collection removal. replace (also the legacy default when omitted) retains full-replacement semantics; never rebuild replacements from redacted reads.

expectedOwnerUserId.description: Recipient precondition, required with privateFields=preserve. Must match the current authenticated owner scope; never selects or grants authority. Retain across retries.

post.description:
STAGED, not admitted: valid authorized requests return 503 native_operations_staged until #379. After future admission, a committed terminal ledger rejection returns REST 409 storage_command_rejected or MCP isError with the same error.rejection: outcome, original operationId, known code and inventoryRevision. Other conflicts/timeouts are not rejection proof. MCP outputSchema describes accepted receipts only; holofolder.com/errorSchemas metadata declares errors. Atomic insertAssign, owned-copy add/edit/remove/unassign/assign/move or collection deletion through the trusted executor. insertAssign creates one stable slot before an exact existing slot reference or appends with before:null, retaining explicit target:null/free or target intent. selection:null creates no ownership; existing requires an exact Unassigned item/version, new explicitly creates that stable item. It never auto-selects a grade or moves an assigned copy. Maximum 4096 slots and 8192 insertion work rows per request, 100 commands, 256 affected selected entities, 256 KiB ordinary request, 1 MiB ordinary receipt and unchanged 16 MiB/16384 audit bounds and 10s deadline; oversized evidence rejects atomically. Full selected-copy/destination and revision preconditions are mandatory. Only explicit removeOwned deletes ownership; idempotent receipts require a fresh complete read before reconciliation. Set privateFields=preserve for add, explicit removeOwned, unassign or placement with fulfillWant:null; patchGrading updates only declared public fields on existing grading; selected-want expectedPublic compares the exact locked slot/index public projection. Hidden certificates/assets/provenance and unrelated wants are retained by migration 090 after original-intent replay lookup. Omitted or replace retains full-replacement semantics.

Required permissions: `collection:write`, `binders:write`. MCP tool: `execute_inventory_commands`.

post.description:
STAGED, not admitted: valid authorized requests return 503 native_operations_staged until #379.  A committed terminal rejection returns REST 409 storage_recovery_rejected or MCP isError with strict error.rejection (outcome, original operationId, code, inventoryRevision). Only recovery_plan_conflict and recovery_dependency_conflict are terminal. Accepted/rejected exact replay precedes mutable plan reconstruction but requires current authority. Preserve unknown requests; status, billing errors and cancellation are not proof. After proof, obtain a fresh complete current owner/session read and explicitly discard, or review a new preview and confirm a new operationId. MCP outputSchema describes accepted receipts only; holofolder.com/errorSchemas metadata declares errors. Apply exactly reviewed native version-1 recovery with confirmation, planToken and retry-stable operationId. Current authority and newer/ABA changes remain enforced. No fallback to legacy recovery.

Required permissions: `collection:read`, `collection:write`, `binders:write`. MCP tool: `apply_storage_recovery`.

get.description:
Read all recorded price evidence with bounded keyset pagination.

Required permissions: `prices:read`. MCP tool: `get_price_history`.

Read private account-lifetime committed collection history. Keyset cursor is bound to filters; private certificates and label assets are redacted. Legacy actors are Unknown. Requires current collection access.

Required permissions: `collection:read`. MCP tool: `list_collection_audit`.

Read one private committed audit event, including safe retained deltas and the original event ID for an undo.

Required permissions: `collection:read`. MCP tool: `get_collection_audit`.

post.description:
Preview a safe undo of complete recorded card and want-list row edits without changing collection data. Collection deletion, settings, native storage and incomplete older events remain unsupported. Returns supported, conflicts, safe changes and a reviewed planToken. Older incomplete events and unsupported dependencies have no token. Requires current access and all listed scopes.

Required permissions: `collection:read`, `collection:write`, `binders:write`. MCP tool: `preview_collection_recovery`.

Undo the exact reviewed card or want-list event atomically with a linked new audit event. Structural/native storage recovery remains gated. Requires confirmed:true, planVersion:1, planToken and a retry-stable operationId. Newer edits, lost access and current limits can block undo. Retry the exact request after an unknown outcome; never generate a new operationId.

Required permissions: `collection:read`, `collection:write`, `binders:write`. MCP tool: `apply_collection_recovery`.
